usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an OpenID Connect realm from Proxmox Datacenter Manager's authentication configuration. Requires the `Realm.Allocate` privilege on `access/domains`. Before deleting, ensure no users or active sessions depend on this realm — removal is immediate and returns null with no undo path.
destructiveReason: Permanently removes the OpenID realm configuration; any users or tokens tied to this realm will lose the ability to authenticate until reassigned to another realm.
tips: Pass the `digest` param (obtained from a prior GET on this realm) to guard against concurrent config modifications before deletion.
Check for dependent user accounts on this realm before deleting — PDM does not block deletion based on existing user associations.
This operation returns null on success; treat a non-error HTTP response as confirmation.
